scientific_integrity: Complete exhaustive C++17 and independently implemented Python verification of maximal independent sets, all support traces, facet counts, boundary ranks; finite proof, not independent professional validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for GP(10,2), not all cubic graphs; mod-two homology only, not integral homology or homotopy type. Known ten equidistant tetrahedra credited to arXiv:2302.14388. Originality is subject to priority uncertainty from unindexed work.
title: The dodecahedral maximal-independent-set shattering complex and its mod-two homology
